    "LC": "Attacker-authored chat instructions directly target the agent's safety decisions, without an independently enforced validation boundary (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:400-441). Regex detection selects a vulnerable response rather than securely mediating the instructions (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/vulnerabilities.js:360-365, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698).",
    "CP": "The documentation models context accumulating across multiple requests, but provides no test confirming isolation after a session boundary (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:400-441). The implementation extracts the latest user turn, while the identified injected-instruction store belongs to MemoryBot; neither verified session persistence nor durable LongwindBot memory is established for the modeled path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160).",
    "AP": "The documented displacement path terminates in LongwindBot's own response, with no demonstrated relay to another agent, tool component, principal, or policy domain (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:400-441, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698). Other fleet agents' delegation and tool capabilities are not reached by this path.",
    "RH": "The acknowledgment is an agent-controlled output channel accepted by the documented success-pattern evaluator, and the simulated handler marks success while merely constructing a response claiming displacement (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:400-441, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698). This makes proxy satisfaction reachable, but the briefing supplies no human-verified reward-hacking episode.",
    "ES": "The assessed path constructs a chat response rather than invoking an extension (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698). LongwindBot's declared search and calculator names do not establish a reachable dynamic extension here, and the optional model completion is text-only (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:681-736, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/llm/provider.js:56-84).",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback binding makes this AV:L; unauthenticated wildcard-CORS agent routes allow a page loaded during ordinary browsing to issue and read requests, supporting UI:P and PR:N, with no additional complexity or execution condition established (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564). As documented, the attack completely removes conversational safety protection, and the corresponding response exposes the persona and credential values, supporting VI:H and modeled VC:H, but no availability or subsequent-system impact (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:400-441, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:683-698). The credentials are planted synthetic data, not demonstrated real-account compromise, and the attacker is not identified as already owning the affected agent (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/vulnerabilities.js:425-448)."
